record.paper: A note on directed analogues of the Sidorenko and forcing conjectures

dossier_meta.paper: A note on directed analogues of the Sidorenko and forcing conjectures
dossier_meta.statement_text: If $B$ is an oriented graph with a homomorphism to an edge and whose underlying undirected graph has a cycle, then $B$ has the directed forcing property.
dossier_meta.context_text: Theorem 1.6 establishes that admitting a homomorphism to a directed edge and having a cycle in the underlying undirected graph are both necessary conditions for the directed forcing property. The authors conjecture these two conditions together are also sufficient, providing a directed analogue of the Skokan–Thoma forcing conjecture.
